sources_quoted.text: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: Unmake is a TYPED amplifier: +12% to MAGIC damage only. The phrase 'from all sources' scopes the set of *dealers* (any ally's magic damage is amplified), not the set of damage types.

sources_quoted.text: {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: Vulnerable is an UNTYPED amplifier: +7% to all damage taken. The current cache carries NO 'bonus magic damage on mark consume' term for Imperial Mandate - the item is pure amp + stats.

sources_quoted.source: data/atoms/items.json -> objects['8020'] (independent atomizer classification of the same branch text)
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: The cache's own atom family for Unmake's amplifier is damage.MAGIC (12 percent), corroborating the type restriction. objects['4005'] (Imperial Mandate) carries no damage.* atom at all - its amp is untyped.

sources_quoted.text: Abyssal Mask: health 350, magicResistance 45, abilityHaste 15, total 2650g. Imperial Mandate: abilityPower 60, abilityHaste 15 (plus 20 AH on immobilizing abilities), total 2400g.
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: Neither item carries any further damage term that could account for the 247.6 delta.

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, Section 2.1 and the Section 5 audit table
sources_quoted.text: m(R) = 100 / (100 + R) (apply_resistance, resistance.py) ... the mitigation operator x -> x*100/(100+R) is linear in raw damage for a fixed resistance
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: Amplifiers scale post-mitigation damage linearly, so an amp applied to the wrong damage-type subset appears as a clean multiplicative shift of exactly that subset - which is what makes the factorization test below valid.

independent_computation.governing_identity: health_damage(participant) = 1.07 * [ sum over that participant's damage entries of post_mitigation_amount * (1.12 if the entry is MAGIC else 1.0) ]  -- Vulnerable (untyped, 7%) multiplies everything; Unmake (typed, 12%) multiplies only the magic entries; mitigation is linear in raw so both amps factor out per entry.

step_1_rule_out_wholesale_amp_changes.note: If breakdown[2]'s damage pool were homogeneous in type, adding or removing an amp wholesale would give one of the ratios below. None reproduces 3269.6 from 3022.0, so whatever changed is necessarily TYPE-SELECTIVE acting on a MIXED pool.

step_2_factorize_the_old_value.claim: 3269.6 is exactly both amps applied to the participant's ENTIRE damage pool, regardless of type.

step_3_solve_the_typed_model_on_that_sam.check: 1.07*1928.3489 + 1.1984*799.9555 = 3022.0 exactly at the leaf's 1-decimal precision (M is 800.0 within that precision)
step_3_solve_the_typed_model_on_that_sam.interpretation: The new value is the old value with Unmake's 12% peeled off the non-magic ~1928.35 of the same pool: 1.07 * 0.12 * 1928.3489 = 247.6, which is the observed delta to the digit. Both amps still apply - untyped 7% on everything, typed 12% on the magic subset, composed multiplicatively.

step_4_the_competing_story_and_why_it_is.story: Alternative reading: the change instead stripped Unmake from this roster member's MAGIC damage entirely (i.e. an ally stopped benefiting from an ally-held Abyssal Mask), which would make the OLD value the correct one.
step_4_the_competing_story_and_why_it_is.why_rejected: The two stories are algebraically symmetric - both peel 0.1284 * 1928.3489 = 247.6 - so the numbers alone cannot decide, and I say so plainly. The decision is made on the source text: the only narrowing clause present anywhere in either item's cached branch text is Unmake's restriction to MAGIC damage, independently corroborated by the cache's own damage.magic atom for item 8020. A model that lets Abyssal Mask's curse amplify a participant's NON-magic damage asserts a broader effect than any cached text supports, and the old value is exactly that model (step 2: a clean 1.07*1.12 over the whole mixed pool). The competing story requires the change to have introduced a fresh contradiction of the 'from all sources' clause rather than to have removed a contradiction of the 'magic damage' clause; the former is a regression with no textual support, the latter is the documented shape of an over-broad-amp fix.

independent_computation.limitation_disclosed: The scenario's input tuple (roster composition, levels, ability ranks, builds, fight window) lives in scripts/ and tests/, outside the permitted evidence tree, so this is not a from-inputs recomputation. What IS independently established from data/ alone: (a) the correct amplifier typing for both items, and (b) that 3269.6 is exactly the both-amps-on-everything value while 3022.0 is exactly the correctly-typed value over the same damage pool.

conclusion: Abyssal Mask's Unmake amplifies MAGIC damage only (+12%, cached branch text and damage.magic atom); Imperial Mandate's Vulnerable amplifies all damage (+7%, cached branch text). The old leaf 3269.6 = 1.07 * 1.12 * 2728.3044 is Unmake applied to the participant's whole mixed pool including its ~1928.35 of non-magic damage. The new leaf 3022.0 = 1.07 * 1928.3489 + 1.07 * 1.12 * 799.9555 is Unmake restricted to the magic subset, with Vulnerable still on everything. The cached wiki text mandates the restriction, so the new value is correct.
